enriched_activities.desc: Lie on the bed. Pull the blanket over the body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to the left side. Bend the knees. Adjust the pillow. Turn to the right side. Stretch the arms. Pull the blanket up. Remain still. Turn onto the back. Place hands on chest. Turn to the left side again. Pull the blanket. Remain still. Wake up briefly. Turn over. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand up. Walk to the bathroom. Turn on the light. Use toilet and flush. Wash hands. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth and wash face. Turn off light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Light stretching, reading and checking phone quietly before breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Stretch arms overhead. Stretch legs forward. Pick up a book and open it. Read a page. Put the book down. Pick up the phone. Press the home button. Check messages. Put the phone down. Close eyes and rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast together with Member 2, brewing coffee with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen. Greet Member 2 with 'Good morning'. Open the refrigerator and take out eggs and milk. Place them on the counter. Take bread and put two slices in the toaster. Press the toaster lever down. Fill the kettle with water and turn it on. Crack eggs into a bowl and whisk. Melt butter in a pan and pour in eggs. Stir eggs and cook. Take toast from the toaster. Pour coffee into mugs. Sit at the table with Member 2. Eat breakfast and drink coffee. Talk with Member 2. Finish eating and pick up plates. Carry plates to the sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and tidying up the kitchen after breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Collect dishes from the table. Scrape food scraps into the trash. Load dishes into the dishwasher. Add dishwasher detergent. Close the dishwasher door. Press the start button. Wipe the counter with a cloth. Put away the butter and milk. Wipe the stove. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Working remotely on the computer, coordinating community programs and replying to emails and calls
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room and sit at the desk. Open the laptop and press the power button. Log in. Open the email client. Read emails and type replies. Pick up the phone and make a call. Speak and hang up. Open the calendar and schedule a meeting. Open a document and edit program schedules. Save the document. Open a web browser and join an online meeting. Mute and unmute the microphone. Speak during the meeting. Take notes. Leave the meeting. Close the laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating lunch together with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the kitchen and greet Member 2. Open the refrigerator and take out vegetables and cheese. Wash and chop vegetables. Make sandwiches. Sit at the table and eat lunch. Talk with Member 2. Finish eating and clear the table.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a short walk around the neighborhood with Member 2 during the lunch break
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Open the front door. Step outside. Walk along the sidewalk. Turn the corner. Walk past the park. Talk with Member 2 about the weather. Turn around. Walk back to the house. Open the front door. Step inside. Take off shoes.
Sit on the sofa. Pick up the phone. Press the home button. Check messages. Put the phone down. Lean back. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing remote work on the computer, planning program schedules and attending online meetings
enriched_activities.desc: Open the laptop. Press the power button. Log in. Open the calendar. Plan program schedules. Open a document. Type schedule details. Save the document. Open the web browser. Join an online meeting. Mute the microphone. Unmute the microphone. Speak during the meeting. Take notes. Leave the meeting. Open email. Read and reply to emails. Close the laptop.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local grocery store and shopping for food and household supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes and pick up reusable bags. Open the front door and step outside. Walk to the grocery store. Enter the store and pick up a basket. Walk to the produce aisle. Select vegetables and put them in the basket. Walk to the dairy aisle. Select milk and cheese and put them in the basket. Walk to the checkout counter. Place items on the belt. Pay with card. Put items in bags. Walk back home. Open the front door. Step inside and take off shoes.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries and starting to prepare dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Place grocery bags on the counter. Open the refrigerator. Put vegetables in the crisper drawer. Put milk and cheese on the shelf. Close the refrigerator. Take out a cutting board. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on the stove.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner together with Member 2, then cleaning up
enriched_activities.desc: Cook dinner on the stove. Stir the pot. Add seasoning. Set the table. Call Member 2 to dinner. Sit at the table with Member 2. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 2. Finish eating. Pick up plates. Carry plates to the sink. Scrape food into the trash. Load dishes into the dishwasher. Add detergent. Close the dishwasher. Press start. Wipe the counter. Turn off the kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing and watching TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit on the sofa with Member 2. Pick up the remote control. Press the power button to turn on the TV. Change channels. Watch a show. Talk with Member 2 about the show. Pick up the phone. Check messages. Put the phone down. Pick up a book. Read a page. Put the book down. Watch more TV. Turn off the TV. Stand up.

Walk to the bathroom and turn on the light. Take off clothes. Turn on the shower and adjust temperature. Step into the shower. Wet body. Apply soap and wash body. Shampoo hair. Rinse body and hair. Turn off the shower and step out. Pick up a towel and dry body. Put on clean clothes. Turn off the light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and reading, unwinding for the evening
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the living room. Sit on the sofa. Pick up the remote. Turn on the TV. Watch a show. Pick up a book. Open the book. Read a chapter. Put the book down. Watch more TV. Pick up the phone. Check messages. Put the phone down. Turn off the TV. Stand up. Walk to the bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Night washing routine and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bathroom and turn on the light. Turn on the tap. Wet face and apply cleanser. Rinse face. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off the tap. Dry face. Turn off the light and walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on, then sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to the bedroom. Turn on the desk lamp. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Get into bed. Pick up a book. Open the book. Read a chapter. Turn the page. Read another chapter. Close the book. Put the book on the nightstand. Turn off the desk lamp. Lie down. Pull the blanket up. Close eyes.
